channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: FAA lifts ground stop after four hours, but flight cancellations will stretch into the weekend
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop on Friday afternoon, disrupting thousands of departing of flights.

item.title: Trump doesn’t plan to raise Nvidia, spy issue during China trip: U.S. officials
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned this week after reports of multiple affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy, Alice Huang.

item.title: Nvidia is done with Jensen Huang. The fallout in Washington is just beginning
item.description: The Republican-led Congress wants to see Jensen Huang in Washington before Democrats take control in January.

item.title: Nasdaq falls on Friday as Nvidia sells off, but index notches best week since August: Live updates
item.description: Nvidia shares rebounded from its recent pressure and the latest inflation data came in slightly lighter than expected.

item.title: Microsoft apologizes for massive outage that took down Outlook and other 365 services
item.description: A Microsoft outage on Thursday and Friday affected users of services like Outlook, Teams and 365.

item.title: SpaceX launches Starship in key test flight of massive rocket
item.description: The test flight is SpaceX's first attempt to ​catch both the Super Heavy booster and upper stage spacecraft of the rocket at its launch site in Starbase, Texas.

item.title: Nvidia turmoil reshuffles the AI trade. Winners, losers and what investors should watch
item.description: Some chipmakers stand to benefit from Nvidia's fallout, but other AI companies face pressure

item.title: Rescues underway in New Orleans after a tanker hits a river cruise boat on the Mississippi River
item.description: A tanker struck a New Orleans river cruise with 129 passengers on board on Friday, partially submerging the boat.

item.title: Nvidia stock suffers longest weekly losing streak since 2012 as market value sinks by $1.7 trillion
item.description: Jensen Huang's resignation added to Nvidia's market woes, with the stock already in a downward slide since early October.

item.title: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds
item.description: The report comes with Wall Street on edge over high-flying AI hyperscalers, while communities are on alert for the rapid spread of data centers.

item.title: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has deep ties to the chipmaker
item.description: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.

item.title: After Jensen Huang’s exit, what top financial advisors are doing with Nvidia: Exclusive CNBC poll
item.description: Advisors say investors should weigh their Nvidia exposure, time horizon and risk tolerance before reacting to the leadership change.

item.title: Hassett denies report he's leaving White House: 'Not true'
item.description: National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett poured cold water on a report that he's expected to leave the White House in the coming weeks.

item.title: This drug wholesaler's transformation is paying off. Here's why the stock still looks attractive
item.description: The largest of America's three big drug wholesalers has outperformed the market this year, but is trading at a discount to its five-year median multiple.

item.title: Retirees sometimes tap savings for one-off expenses. Here’s what advisors say to consider first
item.description: Retirees who need cash for a one-time expense may look to their 401(k) or IRA, but financial advisors say there are trade-offs to weigh first.

item.title: A trading strategy to ride out the Nvidia uncertainty and generate income in the process
item.description: By deploying a persistent covered call strategy, investors can leverage the exact fear driving the stock down to generate robust, risk-reducing income.

item.title: They train people to avoid 'honeypot' scams—here are the common red flags they spot: 'It feels so good to be wanted'
item.description: Corporate security firms train companies and their employees on strategies for being vigilant against honeypots, and other social engineering attacks.

item.title: Wholesale prices rose 0.3% in October, putting annual rate at 6.5%, the highest in nearly four years
item.description: The producer price index was expected to increase 0.4% in October, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

item.title: Supreme Court agrees to hear Robinhood challenge to IPO information omission lawsuit
item.description: The Trump administration had urged the Supreme Court to hear an appeal by Robinhood of a lower-court's decision to revive an investors' lawsuit over the IPO.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, allowing its 'dots' AI agents to make purchases for users
item.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet partners with American Express, Mastercard and Visa, and those cardholders keep their existing credit card rewards.

item.title: Goldman Sachs looks to cash in on big IPOs twice. Anthropic’s historic deal is its next chance
item.description: While co-leading the offering, Goldman also wants a shot at managing the billions of dollars in new wealth that the deal creates. It's not the only one.

item.title: Everyone's fighting for your wallet — but this premium travel card stands above the rest
item.description: Various rewards credit cards have undergone updates in the past year, but one remains at the peak of premium travel: the American Express Platinum Card®.

item.title: Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance—2 habits that take 'a few seconds' can help you avoid similar traps
item.description: Researchers from the Digital Inquiry Group say that two habits that take just "a few seconds up front" can help keep you from being "duped" online.

item.title: Is a bottom in for the Nasdaq-100? Charts to watch

item.title: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee says central bank 'has definitely got work to do' on inflation
item.description: The policymaker expressed concern about the latest inflation data, telling CNBC that the central bank likely will need to take action.

item.title: Why the data center slowdown concern is overblown. Two stocks to buy amid the fear
item.description: Not one utility CEO we spoke with at the EEI conference is anticipating a slowdown in electricity growth expectations.

item.title: What's ahead for AI financing after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang departs

item.title: Trump says he wants to ‘get Cuba done’ before leaving office, would consider military force
item.description: It comes as the U.S. continues to enforce a comprehensive economic embargo against Cuba.

item.title: Jensen Huang scandal casts doubt on Nvidia’s AI dominance — how we got here
